selfContacts.scope: Within one object only; excludes same-polygon, shared-index, and shared-position pairs.
selfContacts.method: BVH broad phase, then closed triangle SAT; contact includes tangency and coplanar overlap.

positions.note: Coincident UV/material seam vertices are not automatically defects.

topology.note: Connectivity is by vertex indices; split seams can produce multiple components. Boundary edges can be intentional garment openings. Vertex-fan manifoldness not tested.

normals.note: Winding consistency and signed volume are diagnostics. Outwardness of open/multi-shell surfaces needs visual review.

uvLayers.note: Outside [0,1] can be intentional tiling. This is not a UV overlap or stretch audit.

selfContacts.scope: Within one object only; excludes same-polygon, shared-index, and shared-position pairs.

limitations: No artistic acceptance, silhouette identity, texture bleed, or finger-count certification.
No inter-object collisions, animation, global self-intersection, UV overlap or UV stretch certification.
Signed volume does not prove outward normals on open or multiple nested shells.
Self-contact reports include touching, exclude shared positions and are bounded per explicit object.
